subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Tom's uncle opened a small noodle shop.”?
options: One day, Mrs. Lin cut an ugly apple into pieces and let customers try it.
On the first day, Tom helped clean tables and bring water to customers.
Nina took the wrong bus on her first day at a new school.
The teacher quickly helped him clean it, but a small mark remained.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One day, Mrs. Lin cut an ugly apple into pieces and let customers try it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「On the first day, Tom helped clean tables and bring water to customers.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Nina took the wrong bus on her first day at a new school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher quickly helped him clean it, but a small mark remained.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「On the first day, Tom helped clean tables and bring water to customers.」，答案為「On the first day, Tom helped clean tables and bring water to customers.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「On the first day, Tom helped clean tables and bring water to customers.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
